mapper.select: SELECT t.table_name AS id, t.table_name AS table_name, COALESCE(obj_description((quote_ident(t.table_schema) || '.' || quote_ident(t.table_name))::regclass, 'pg_class'), '') AS table_comment, NULL AS create_time FROM information_schema.tables t WHERE t.table_schema = current_schema() AND t.table_type = 'BASE TABLE' ORDER BY t.table_name DESC
